title: Harden Reports WebView triage and cleanup controls
summary: Harden Reports UI selection scope, marker cleanup preview feedback, audit command busy states, severity display, owner navigation, and report-location open feedback without changing backend routes or media policy.
reason: The Reports audit found ambiguous hidden selections, all-marker cleanup scope, duplicate command risk, weak severity coloring, weak owner handoff, and flaky browser-smoke tab assertions.
behavior_before: Reports preserved hidden selections without visible blocking, all-marker cleanup labels were ambiguous, audit command buttons could be double-clicked, failure severity could render as unmapped raw status text, owner handoff was mostly text, and report path opens had weak inline feedback.
behavior_after: Reports blocks selected actions with hidden selections, requires all-marker preview before all-marker clear, guards audit and cleanup command submissions, normalizes failure severity chips, provides local owner navigation, and shows inline report open feedback.
manual_validation: python -m py_compile focused Reports tests - passed
rollback_plan: Revert the Reports WebView asset, Reports partial, focused Reports tests, generated summaries, and this change packet, then rerun the Reports static test and browser smoke.
notes:
Implements the Reports UI remediation plan requested on 2026-06-18. This is WebView-only and must not add backend routes or media/filesystem mutation behavior.
Focused Reports UI remediation implemented with browser smoke coverage for hidden selection blocking, preview-gated all-marker cleanup, audit busy guards, owner navigation, inline location open feedback, tab waits, and 250-row cap messaging.
